mapper.select: SELECT * FROM appointment WHERE eir_id = #{eirId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM appointment WHERE eir_id = #{eirId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment (eir_id, plate_no, appt_date, time_slot, status, driver_id, voucher_no) VALUES (#{eirId}, #{plateNo}, #{apptDate}, #{timeSlot}, #{status}, #{driverId}, #{voucherNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE appointment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM appointment WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND verify_time IS NULL AND (appt_date < CURDATE() OR (appt_date = CURDATE() AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(time_slot, '-', -1) < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%H:%i')))
SELECT * FROM appointment WHERE voucher_no = #{voucherNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.* FROM appointment a JOIN eir_order e ON e.id = a.eir_id WHERE e.tractor_id = #{tractorId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, CONCAT(a.appt_date, ' ', LEFT(a.time_slot, 5)), NOW())), a.id DESC
SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(voucher_no, 12) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM appointment WHERE voucher_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
